C.8F.v: U.S. citizens and permanent residents, undocumented and DACA applicants : Submission of standardized test scores as a part of the application to Smith College is optional. Smith welcomes applications from undocumented and Deferred Action for Childhood Arrival (DACA) students. These students follow the same requirements as U.S. citizens and permanent residents when applying to Smith. Submission of SAT or ACT scores is optional. International citizens : Submission of SAT or ACT scores is optional. International citizens whose primary language is not English or have not attended a school at which English is the primary language of instruction will be required to submit TOEFL, IELTS, PTE or Duolingo English test scores. Applicants may be exempt from this requirement if they: identify English as their first language, have attended a school in which the primary language of the institution is English for the duration of their secondary school career, have attended school in the U.S. and instructed in English for at least two years, or are enrolled in or have completed the IB Diploma Program or A level curriculum taught in English.
